listings.title: Research Data Expert
listings.description:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking a Research Data Expert to join our Data team. Data is a cornerstone of HRT’s trading strategies, serving as the raw fuel that powers research, automated trading, and risk management.

In this role, you will own a specific area of expertise, working on sourcing junior data engineers, platform engineers, and alpha researchers to build and maintain trading strategies. You will also be responsible for providing fully featurized datasets to statistical modeling researchers.

HRT does not have information siloes. You will be collaborating directly with our researchers and will be responsible for driving  the business forward through rigorous data analysis and delivery. You will also manage the full end-to-end pipeline from vendor downloads to trading-ready data. As an expert in one area, you will mentor junior data engineers, assisting and validating their work, and will partner with our sourcing team to identify optimal opportunities for data procurement. Furthermore, you will be responsible for ensuring high-quality service by implementing rigorous data checks and alerts.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain fully featurized datasets for statistical modeling research
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for a designated data domain
  • Provide technical support and guidance to researchers on vendor data and derived datasets
  • Mentor and direct junior data engineers, including performing code and data output validation
  • Partner with the sourcing team to identify and evaluate new data procurement opportunities
  • Analyze data to identify and improve alpha
  • Manage the full end-to-end data pipeline, from raw vendor ingestion to refined feature sets
  • Provide on-call support for data issues during normal business hours
  • Design and implement automated data quality checks and monitoring alerts

listings.title: Senior Product Engineer (Full-Stack)
listings.description:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Founded in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN, Proton was built on the belief that privacy is a fundamental human right. What started as an encrypted email service has grown into an ecosystem of privacy-first products, including Proton Mail, VPN, Drive, Pass, and Calendar, used by millions of people worldwide.

We're profitable, independent, and building for the long term. Free from venture capital control and advertising-driven business models, we focus on what matters most: our users. Our work helps protect digital freedom, from everyday privacy to supporting journalists and activists in challenging environments.

Today, we're an international team of 700+ people, with offices across 9 countries. We have high standards for the people we hire and the work we do. You'll work alongside talented, driven colleagues who challenge each other, take ownership, and care about getting things right.

Explore our open-source projects.

Your impact:

We’re hiring Product Engineers at senior and staff levels. If you’ve led complex technical projects and want to keep building hands-on, we’d love to hear from you. Your scope and level will reflect your experience and the impact you can bring.

As a Senior Product Engineer (Full-Stack), you’ll help shape what we build and own work from understanding the problem through to release and improvement. You’ll speak directly with customers, collaborate with Product and Design, and work across the parts of the stack needed to deliver a complete solution.

What you will do:

  • Understand and shape the problem: Work with Product, Design and customers to understand user needs, question assumptions and decide what is worth building.
  • Own complete

listings.description: TL;DR - We're looking for a hands-on paid social marketer to run Meta as our core channel and test other social platforms. You'll build agents with Lovable that read performance, move budgets, catch issues, and make changes. Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. listings.title: Lead Architect – Digital Assets & Tokenization
listings.description: Location: Paris, France (4 days onsite per week) Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time Salary: €100,000 – €120,000 gross/year About the Opportunity We are partnering with a leading European financial market infrastructure group to build a new Digital Assets division, focused on tokenisation and Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT). The mission is to develop next-generation financial infrastructure, launch innovative digital asset products for institutional and retail clients, and bridge traditional finance (TradFi) with decentralised finance (DeFi). This is a unique founding-style leadership opportunity within an established, highly regulated financial institution. You will have the opportunity to shape the technical vision, own the architecture, and build foundational technology from the ground up. The Mission You will lead the architecture of the organisation's first tokenised financial products, covering two major initiatives: Tokenised Securities Platform: Building an issuance, trading and settlement platform for equities, ETFs and bonds, featuring 24/7 trading, fractional ownership and on-chain Delivery-versus-Payment (DvP) settlement. listings.title: Head of Operational Integration
listings.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will build software that runs on real drones. You will take Auterion’s platform into a specific customer program and make it work on their hardware, for their mission, in the field.

You will work directly with partners and customers, as well as with Auterion’s core platform, hardware and flight test teams. Between trips, you will work from our Munich office, both at your desk and on the bench.

No drone experience is required. If you have integrated software on cars, robots, industrial machines or other embedded systems, you already have the right foundation, and we will teach you the drone side.

listings.description: About us Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains. About the team The SABR team owns the top layer of request processing for product discovery. We own the service that first receives product discovery requests (autocomplete, search, browse & recommendations) & executes the entire business logic that drives product discovery. That service also functions as a gateway to parse incoming user requests, orchestrate calls across the internal services that do the ranking and retrieval, interpret their responses, and assemble the final response the customer sees. We also own the public configuration APIs customers use to control how discovery behaves, and the MCP layer that exposes all of it to AI agents. Our team owns both platform & product components: Because of the positioning of our services, we take part in every architectural decision of our core product offering. At the same time, our goals are heavily influenced by direct customer feedback, because all product discovery-related features are either implemented in or integrated with our services. All of our services are public APIs, so interface design and backward compatibility are a constant part of the job. But most of our attention goes to keeping them fast and up: we serve up to 15k RPS, fan out to many internal services on every request, and are expected to stay available and degrade gracefully when any of them fails or slows down. The work is distributed systems in practice rather than in theory: request orchestration, failure isolation, caching, latency budgets, capacity planning, and the observability to know what is actually happening in production. listings.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. As a key member of our System Team, you will play a central role in developing key fluid systems of the engine. Define and manage the verification and validation strategy, including requirements, test specifications, acceptance criteria, and evidence of compliance. Design and specify the pneumatic equipment required to support demonstrator test campaigns and test-article operations. Feed test results and lessons learned back into system design, requirements, and future development activities. About the job

Turn AI research ideas into experiments that help shape Graphcore’s next generation of AI hardware.

As a Staff Research Engineer in Graphcore Research, you’ll help shape complex projects from hypothesis to evaluation. You can join the team in Bristol, London or Cambridge.

Our research spans efficient training and inference, numerics, reinforcement learning, and more. You’ll build implementations and algorithms that scale and explore how choices in model design and execution affect hardware efficiency.

Your work will help to push AI models past the frontier, while turning the results of your work into recommendations that silicon and software engineers can use in their designs. You will explain to various groups which trade-offs matter as models grow and where bottlenecks emerge.

You’ll also prepare papers and present findings at AI conferences and specialist workshops. 

The team and culture

Researchers across Bristol, London and Cambridge shape projects around shared research interests. You might work with colleagues to investigate how a model scales,  trace a distributed inference bottleneck, or develop an algorithm that enables training with more efficient number formats. 

Research team bring a customer perspective and experience making models and software work on Graphcore’s stack at scale. Together, the teams develop ideas in efficient compute, model scaling and distributed training and inference.

Graphcore Research works with research groups around the world and publishes at venues including NeurIPS, ICML and ICLR.

What we’re looking for

  • A PhD or equivalent experience in a technical discipline such as mathematics, statistics, computer science, physics or chemistry.
  • Python skills with a framework such as PyTorch or JAX, with experience in model design, optimisation, evaluation and scaling.

listings.description: Meet Arago and the Aragonians Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles. The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance. Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders. Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work. What you’ll do Arago designs its own SoCs. As Silicon Operations Manager, you will own everything after design, from foundry handoff to volume production. You pick up the chip once front-end and physical design are done, and you are accountable for getting working parts in volume. Ils ont supplanté une partie des algorithmes de Data Science plus « classiques ». Cependant, ils ne sont pas exempts de défauts. Nous venons par ailleurs de vivre en France, une série de canicules les plus importantes de ces dernières décennies, avec des records de température dans de nombreuses villes françaises. Il est nécessaire de prendre des actions pour aller vers des technologies plus sobres en énergie. listings.title: Senior Security GRC Engineer
listings.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

The role is part of the Security Function within the broader Mozilla Infrastructure team. The Security team supports Product, Enterprise and GRC functions across the organization aligned with the mission to build a safe & secure internet. This role is responsible for defining, developing and helping implement a Governance, Risk and Compliance framework for both Enterprise and Product verticals. The ideal candidate will be responsible to deliver an integrated framework that aligns security, privacy, regulatory, and risk management initiatives across the organization. This is an ideal role for someone early in their GRC or security career who is curious, organized, and eager to take on a wide range of work. You’ll get broad exposure across risk, audit, and a growing set of security programs.

listings.description: Job Title: Patient Care Advocate Job Location: Remote About Us: We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. Role Overview: As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. What You’ll Do: Patient Enrollment & Eligibility : Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. Prescription Coverage : Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. Cost-Sharing & Payment : Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. Prescription Fulfillment : Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. Refills & Continued Use : Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. Program Renewal & Updates : Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary.
